test_title: PYST 40: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, “CLIENT” is written as “LCEITN”, and “CLOSED” is written as “LCSODE”. How will “FAMILY” be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of English alphabets is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

“CLIENT” is written as “LCEITN”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a080fead7b874c71cb074352273c4db71b71ec978eb8556c600f203abe569bc1.png] 

“CLOSED” is written as “LCSODE”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/850e099ff428eb4e199872a99c1009577c00123700f1e18e75322839a472b036.png] 

Similarly, “FAMILY” will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43797468b1afc784ef463dc6047bc53f4540be1228f4ac85e74066cb985b1315.png] 

Hence, **'**AFIMYL**'** is the correct answer.
tags: Coding and Decoding By Letter Shifting
